links.outcome: Accuracy of numeric answers from ChatGPT-4 versus Google Search, rated by blinded surgeons
links.effect: Mean accuracy 2.9 ± 0.9 for ChatGPT-4 versus 2.5 ± 1.4 for Google (P = .65); no significant difference, though ChatGPT-4 used only academic sources versus 30% for Google (P = .003).
links.quote: Mean (± standard deviation) accuracy to numeric-based answers was 2.9 ± 0.9 for ChatGPT-4 versus 2.5 ± 1.4 for Google (P = .65).

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT-4's accuracy and source reliability compared to Google Search for answering patient questions about the Latarjet procedure; does not test a specific deployment safeguard or practice.
